question.text: $\mathrm{OF}$ and $\mathrm{F}_2$ can be compared in terms of

options.text: OF is more stable towards dissociation into atoms
None of the above is correct

solution.text: This is one unpaired electron in $(\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{F})$, hence paramagnetic, thus (a) is correct. As bond order of $\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{F}>\mathrm{F}-\mathrm{F}$ thus, bond energy of $\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{F}>\mathrm{F}-\mathrm{F}$. Hence, (a) and (b) both are correct.
